item.title: Woodland Clan
item.description: Wood Elves are nobility based strictly on their race. Consists of two lines: Upper Branches and Lower Roots. Those of the Branches are most commonly seen with the Royal Family and others of high status/wealth. Those of the Lower Roots are well-respected in the general public but are overshadowed within the Woodland Clan. item.title: Esemone, Institute of the Arcana
item.description: Offers Bachelors of Magic degrees. Gives minors/Masters in Abjuration, Conjuration, Divination, Necromancy, and Magical Theory. (Can make more.) Has clubs of valor and lore.  WIP Esemone’s library, the Enna, consists of three main sections: the entrance, the main hall, and the tower.The Entrance has a coffee shop on one wall and a visitor kiosk on the opposite wall. The back wall is an open entryway with a magical gate that restricts access to students, faculty, and those given permission.The Main Hall is all one floor and is about one-and-a-half stories all. The Hall has two open walls, one that connects to the Entrance and another to the Tower. The remaining walls are covered floor-to-ceiling with bookshelves. In the center of the Hall is an information kiosk. The rest of the floor is filled with a variety of chairs, tables, and couches. Even the bookshelves have embedded nooks at different levels with extra sitting space.Books in the Hall include general information such as history textbooks, popular memoirs and fundamental texts. For ease of access, the information kiosk houses ‘search scrolls’ that indexes all the books in the library. However depending on a student’s access, certain books are not available to read or check-out. Excluding the ceiling-high ladders, light sprites can also be used to retrieve books for students.The Tower is divided into four floors. Each floor focuses on a specific field that Esemone is known for. From bottom to top: Abjuration, Conjuration, Necromancy, and Divination. To access any higher floors, a magic user has to activate a levitation circle that’s in the center of each floor. Anyone with library access can visit any floor (minus Necromancy) but won’t be able to read high-level or degree-specific texts.

item.title: Clash in Akkins
item.description: 3100 ~ 3200 After fifty years of abuse, the people of Anemone clashed physically with the IVORY GUARDS stationed in Akkins, Anemone. The clash began when someone threw a molotov cocktail at an Ivory Guard. Five Ivory Guards and eighteen civilians died in the altercation.

item.title: The Neverending Storms
item.description: Angered by the Clash in Akkins and emboldened with the Waterbearer patronage, Queen Enna summoned devastating storms all across Anemone. IVORY GUARDS utilized military-grade domains to create safe zones in strategic locations across the city. In order to enter these safe zones, each citizen of Anemone was throughly checked. As none of the cities were designed to withstand such weather disasters, sections of Anemone were flooded for months afterwards. Repairs took years to complete.

item.title: Architecture
item.description: The physical walls that boarder other cities are thiner and shorter than the outermost walls. The outermost walls are about thirteen miles (20.9 km) in height, and the inner cities' walls are about 6 miles (9.65 km) in height. The physical walls seemingly extend infinitely underground, and attempts to find the end in the past have led to devastating casualties. All air travel has a maximum altitude of the innermost walls’ height before simply being unable to work. The magical walls are best seen from the sky. A iridescent shimmer can be seen in certain lighting from above as it makes a seemingly dome shape across the kingdom. Magic users and philosophers have hypothesized that the day and night cycle is simulated by the magical barrier. Records show all types of weather patterns to have occurred in the past, but in recent centuries extreme weather changes have come far and few between. Structures dating back to the foundation of Eora were made primarily of wood. As the kingdom grew, newer constructions were built from metal and concrete. Pure wooden fixtures are seen as a symbol of wealth and status. Faux greenery is common, but is easily identifiable as such with a closer view. Real greenery is rare, and only grows where blessed soil has been placed. Because of this, real greenery in most public places is strictly maintained by the government and religious institution. The biggest example of this is The Garden. Privately owned gardens and greenery are seen as a symbol of wealth and status.

item.title: Communication
item.description:
Most common form of long-distance communication across all cities. Is used most in Anemone. Letters and packages are delivered through postal services.When relaying information to large groups of people, notice boards and newspapers are used. 
People who have permits to operate single or dual-person airships. Is used most in Edelweiss to deliver letters and packages. 
Mechanical messenger birds that are used to deliver letter and small packages. Are usually enchanted against damage or dampening, and sent to a specific person or business. Are used most in Hollyhock. These are typically owned by individuals, but sometimes postal services will offer them for an extra fee. Because of their design, cycranes are expensive and commonly used by nobility, the government, and wealthier businesses.
The Greenwire is a communication network unique to Amaryllis. Artificial vines are magically connected to the roots of The Garden tree. Rosettes are then attached to the artificial vines and can be found all over the city to send messages.Public rosettes connect to each other by knowing/visualizing the district, neighborhood, and street it’s located in. Public rosettes only support live communication and require money to operate. Private rosettes require familiarity with the destination it’s housed in. Private rosettes can store the messages in written and spoken form.

item.title: Agriculture
item.description:
Most soil throughout the kingdom lacks the ability to produce life. Fertile (or blessed) soil is the most regulated resource, and is soil blessed by Emer during the foundation of Eora. The blessed soil was given to the Royal Family to manage, and possessing even a small portion of it is a sign of great wealth and status. A massive amount of blessed soil was donated to The Garden when it was being constructed, and a large tree grew from it. This tree became the centerpieces of Amaryllis.  
Water is the second most regulated resource in Eora. Initially it was also given to the Royal Family to manage, but as Eora grew, the responsibility was handed over to the Head Councilman of Water and their respective boards.
All water is sourced from the Well. The Well is a reservoir of water underneath The Oasis. During the Blessing of the Waterbearer, the Well is replenished. Pure water is primarily reserved for hydroponic farming. Pure water is rarely used for public distribution, and is expensive to purchase for drinking.   Agriculture is heavily reliant on hydroponic farming. High-value crops use blessed soil. Because of limited resources, there is an emphasis on high-yield crops along with heavy food processing and manufacturing. Spices and other agricultural products are produced through industrial means. Livestock farming has remained consistent throughout Eora's history. Meat and poultry are staples in the kingdom's food supply.

item.title: RELIGION
item.description:
Over six thousand years ago, the Shadow Flood swept across the lands and consumed everything in its path. To protect those remaining, the 3 True Gods created the Kingdom of Eora as a haven. Vulcan the Inventor, created the kingdom's foundations using his omnipotent knowledge of technology. Tempest the Waterbearer, graced the kingdom with water, its primary resource. Emer of the Soil gave the kingdom life giving it a precious amount of soil, crops, and animals. Soon after establishing the Kingdom of Eora, the True Gods hand-picked and blessed a Dark Elven family (the Pacifics) that would become the Royal Family. The Waterbearer then chose the First Queen of Eora, and the line of succession has run through women ever since. Once the surviving populace was safe within Eora’s walls, the True Gods spent and continued to spend their time battling against the Shadow Flood. They do this with the hope that one day the survivors will be able to walk the earth freely once again.  Tempest, the Waterbearer
Vulcan, the Inventor
Emer of the Lost Soil

item.title: Emer of the Lost Soil
item.description: In official texts, Emer is imagined as an older woman with brown coiled hair. Her eyes are typically brown or green, but her outfit varies wildly by artist. She’s been depicted wearing farmer clothes, extravagant dresses, and commoner outfits. Her immaterial forms include rumbling earth, crunched leaves, and sounds of nature.Emer’s symbol is of a rose, although any plant imagery can be attributed to her.Historians believe her to be the oldest of the True Gods, and they read about her maturity and wisdom in solving conflicts of long past. Emer is viewed as a gentle and maternal-like figure, although in recent centuries her influence has started to become overshadowed by her fellow gods. Emer is the goddess of soil, creatures and remembrance. Her followers are often found in roles relating to preservation. Famous historians, record-keepers, and scribes are known to be devout believers. Farmers are also known to ask for her blessing over crops and animals. The Garden. Located in Arcadia, Amaryllis. UNKNOWN
item.guid: 2. WORLD/2.3 RELIGION/2.31 TRUE GODS/Emer of the Lost Soil.md

item.title: Tempest, the Waterbearer
item.description: In official texts, the Waterbearer is depicted as a willowy woman with dark, liquid-like hair. Her eyes and outfit defer by the artist, but typically she has either blue or black colored eyes, and wears an extravagant dress in shades of blue. The Waterbearer is often shown holding an urn or large bowl, pouring water into fields or into the Well. Her immaterial forms include crashing/rushing water and calming/booming rain.The original symbol of the Waterbearer was of a sea shell. In modern times, her worshippers made a water droplet her official symbol. Stories of the Waterbearer write her as a benevolent being with an incredible temperament and pose. She is a being that rules above all others and is something to look up to.The Waterbearer is the deity of water, change and choice. Those that follow her are the cornerstones adapting to and creating change. They embody kindness, calmness, and the willingness to “go with the flow.” Their beliefs revolve around the ability to make their own choices and pave their own destiny. The Oasis. Located in Queen's Sphere, Hollyhock. UNKNOWN
item.guid: 2. WORLD/2.3 RELIGION/2.31 TRUE GODS/Tempest, the Waterbearer.md

item.title: Vulcan, the Inventor
item.description:
The earliest depictions of the Inventor show him as a whimsical young man. Wavy blond hair and mischievous gray eyes were common features across different illustrations. After the Salvation, his image was aged to be of an older man with graying blond hair and solemn gray eyes. His clothing changes often, and is largely dependent on the current trends. His immaterial forms include the clattering of tools, the hum of running machinery, and the ticking of a clock.The Inventor’s symbol is of a clock, one of humanity’s greatest inventions.Due to the earliest recorded images of him, many believe that the Inventor is the youngest of the True Gods. However, he has aged the most over the centuries, and is seen as a great educator and philosopher.The Inventor is the god of technology, creativity and innovation. His believers can typically be found amongst architects, mechanics and those with a penchant for tinkering. Many renowned inventors attribute some of their greatest inventions to visions from the Inventor. Those that follow him embody the conviction to “try, try, and try again.” The Exhibit. Located in Nexus, Edelweiss.
A satellite temple is located in Akkins, Anemone.
item.guid: 2. WORLD/2.3 RELIGION/2.31 TRUE GODS/Vulcan, the Inventor.md

item.title: ROYALTY
item.description:
The Royal Family, the Pacifics, have been ruling Eora since its conception. The current ruler is Queen Erza, the 13th Queen. Princess Penelope is the Queen’s only daughter and heir to the throne. The title of Queen is traditionally passed from mother to daughter, and exclusively through the Pacific bloodline. Every Queen has given birth to a daughter, and many believe this to be a blessing and sign from the Waterbearer. Previous Queens that have had multiple children were rarely seen in a positive light by the kingdom. Those eras were often muddled with unnecessary succession disputes, and rising tensions within Eora.
Queen Erza
Princess Penelope King Consorts historically hold little political power themselves, but can grant nobility to their close relatives and elevate their status. Many of these families grow to hold near-permanent seats on different Boards, produce influential civil servants, and own a vast network of companies. 
The Royal Family has always resided in The Pacific Estate, located in Queen's Sphere, Hollyhock. Longstanding nobility also have homes in the Estate, but most families live outside of it.

item.title: Transportation
item.description: When traveling within a city, walking or catching a train is the most common. Walking the diameter of a city would take about 20 hours if moving nonstop. There is no straight line through a city, so walking the length of one includes a lot of twists and turns. Walking from one district to another is possible, but is simply not time efficient. Most folks walk between streets and neighborhoods. Trains are the most popular means of transportation across all cities. Normal (or local) trains are used to travel between districts in the same city. Many of these local trains were built hundreds of years ago, so upkeep is dependent on each city. Along a single train line, there can be multiple stops (or connections). A passenger can be charged for traveling across the entire line or per connection. Each connection is about 1-2 hours long. 2 cp per connection, or 6 cp per line. Yearly passes can be up to 20 sp. Other means of traveling are city-dependent. Edelweiss is known for popularizing airboards (or just “boards”) that children use to travel short distances. Windriders are compact, single or dual-person airships that are built to fly just above most buildings. They are more convenient and faster than local trains, but require a permit from the Zeppelin Flight Academy to fly. Hollyhock is known for popularizing steelhorses, a mechanical marvel that mimics creatures of old. It’s incredibly expensive to purchase and maintain, so it is seen as a symbol of wealth.  When traveling between cities, catching a train or flying by airship is most common. Walking between cities is illegal. During the foundation of Eora, there were walkable streets that allowed for traveling, but those have all been either repurposed or shutdown. There use to be local trains that ran between cities, but those railroads were repurposed for the new (or bullet) trains. Bullet trains are the official means of traveling between cities by land. These trains are fast, and are more expensive than local trains. Each stop at a city takes about 3-4 hours. 2 sp per stop. Yearly passes can be up to 5 gp. Airships are used to carry a large amount of people to one location. Commercial airships travel to each city, and are a bit faster than bullet trains. Airships are typically used when wanting to quickly cross the entirety of Eora. Each stop at a city takes about 2-3 hours. 5 gp per stop. Yearly passes can be up to 100 gp.

will be at a tavern about a block away incase anything goes sideways the duo stake out the store until they see the 2 owners returning. once all the lights are out from the windows, the duo sneaks inside via lock picking the front door with invisibility Irosys steals money from the cash register while Thia looks around the employee-only room (the backrooms) Thia investigates the backrooms and finds/takes logs of shipments between TOYS & TREATS and locations in Edelweiss Irosys joins Thia in the backrooms and deletes the footage of the duo sneaking in from the camera storage box the duo finds a trapdoor underneath a rug and they take the rope down into a subterranean tunnel/hallway. they step on small, subtle pressure plates but are able to dodge the darts that activate the duo sneaks through the remaining hallway and overhear the 2 owners talking in an adjacent room about Zeke during all of this, Diaspro tries to send a message to Thia but the magic seems to bounce back. worried, Diaspro and Kaimop leave Wynn at the tavern and also break into TOYS & TREATS Irosys and Thia try to sneak undetected into the adjacent underground room, but the owners realize that someone has snuck in the room has a desk, boxes and a blackboard hanging on the wall the blackboard is magically blurred, but Thia is able to read 8 locations on a map tacked to the board. a list of names are also tacked on but Thia is unable to read them Irosys makes his way to to the desk, but before he could investigate anything the owners magically seal the duo in the room and gas the inside Irosys and Thia immediately take poison damage and Irosys falls asleep Diaspro hears the commotion and climbs down into the underground hallway. she breaks the magical barrier surrounding the room and escapes back up as the gas spreads into the hallway Diaspro then calls for Kaimop (who was on the second floor of the shop)

item.title: SESSION 17 RECAP
item.description: night - Mar 19 (Mon) before making their way to the Akkins district, Diaspro makes 3 dust potions for the party on the way to the satellite temple of the Inventor, the party sees a woman getting attacked by shadowy creatures. the party saves the woman just before the Queen's Cinders arrive the party runs away before the Cinders spot them, and leaves the woman in the Cinders' care while at the satellite temple, Diaspro tries talking to the Inventor and asks him a few questions: she asks about the shadowy creatures and what's being done to combat them, and he says that he's "inspiring someone close to her" she also asks about the Balance and essentially gets told to stop talking about it Diaspro angrily drags the party out of the satellite temple and they discuss their plan of sneaking into TOYS & TREATS

item.title: SESSION 16 RECAP
item.description: night - Mar 19 (Mon) the party meet up at the Last Line tavern and discuss their next steps the party plans to: (1) assist Diaspro in her ritual suicide plan and then (2) sneak into TOYS & TREATS after committing to the ritual, Diaspro finds herself in a limbo between life and death. while there, she’s able to ask a previous owner of the obsidian dagger - Princess Enna - a few questions the being lurking in the in-between, the Balance, is then incited to save Diaspro before she sinks into the Under the Balance answers Diaspro’s questions before sending her back to the realm of the living however before Diaspro returns, she finds herself reliving a memory of Princess Enna falling in the air alive once again, Diaspro retells what she experienced to the party and makes plans to visit the satellite temple of the Inventor before sneaking into the candy shop

item.title: SESSION 15 RECAP
item.description: only Wynn, Irosys, and Diaspro day - Mar 19 (Mon) Wynn, Irosys and Diaspro leave the Enna and meet with Diaspro's academic advisor. talking with him leads to: Diaspro asking for a recommendation letter to gain access to the Grand Library Wynn, with Diaspro's backing, gives her academic records to the advisor the advisor suggests visiting a graduate professor named Arah Nelate for divination help before making their way back to the city of Anemone, the trio makes a stop at a spell scroll shop. at the shop they buy 8 spell scrolls. Diaspro has: Identify, Disguise Self and Augury. Wynn has: Gentle Repose and Speak with Dead. Irosys has: Chromatic Orb and Blur

item.title: SESSION 14.5 RECAP
item.description: only Kaimop and Thia day - Mar 19 (Mon) Kaimop and Thia briefly talk to Orvel and buy candy from his shop the duo went to a local Toys 'R Us and couldn't find a similar dragon toy to the one they saw at the Tally house the duo then traveled back to the Akkins District to the visit TOYS & TREATS. this store is a few blocks away from the the Inventor satellite temple, and was mentioned by Ava Tally when talking to her while in the store, the duo is mindful of cameras and notices a defective doll hidden behind rows of other dolls the duo chats with the part-timer that mans the checkout as they try to purchase the defective doll, but are stopped by the owners returning to the shop the two owners - Tanya and "Jabra" - manage to take the doll to the backroom before returning it and selling it to the duo. the duo also request (and pay an advance for) a custom male version of the defective doll that they can pick up in about 2 days

item.title: SESSION 14 RECAP
item.description: only Wynn, Irosys, and Diaspro day - Mar 19 (Mon) Wynn, Irosys and Diaspro travel to the city of Amaryllis to visit Esemone Institute’s library on the way, the trio quickly visit Diaspro’s loft in the district of Crystalview Esemone’s library - the Enna - houses information for its four main undergraduate degrees Irosys and Wynn get visitor passes through Diaspro before being allowed into the library once inside, Diaspro uses her graduate-student access to search an array of key terms/words in order to find useful books the books (so far): “From Before - A Collection of Short Stories” “History of the Inciting Incidents : Volume 1”

item.title: SESSION 13.5 RECAP
item.description: only Kaimop and Thia day - Mar 19 (Mon) when Kaimop and Thia meet with Ava Tally, they hand over the list of questions that the party pooled together Ava goes through each question and answers them truthfully, but she refuses to answer any questions relating to Igyln and whatever the white thal miners are doing the duo then heads to the Half-Full Flask and talk to Hez the tavernkeeper Hez details seeing Russel on the night he got caught walking to the shack, and had showed his camera footage to some AoP when they visited to investigate afterwards, Kaimop and Thia walk over to Orvel's Sweet Delights - a candy store that Hez mentioned Russel likes the frequent

item.title: SESSION 13 RECAP
item.description: night - Mar 18 (Sun) after defeating the 3 thugs at the Last Line tavern, Cel tells the party (minus Irosys) to quickly get rid of the bodies due to them having identifiers that could be traced back to the tavern. Cel uncovers an interesting note from one of the thugs, and identifies all 3 of them as part of Oxide Diaspro kills the 3 Oxide members before they dispose the bodies a few blocks away Cel calls for Xavier and Belle (the pink-skinned tiefling), and has her explain what mess she got herself into important points from that discussion: the note from the Oxide member details an exchange of units of “candlewake” (a drug) Belle was caught snooping on this exchange and was chased to the Last Line Tavern Belle is part of a larger rival gang that’s snooping on Oxide on behalf of another illegal group the party (minus Irosys) all head to bed day - Mar 19 (Mon) Irosys rejoins the party, and while eating the breakfast the party discuss what to do the party decides to split up: Kai and Thia will go and revisit Ava Tally; and Wynn, Irosys and Diaspro will travel to Amaryllis to visit Esemone’s library the party come up with a list of questions for Ava that Kaimop and Thia will ask her

item.title: SESSION 11.5 RECAP
item.description: only Irosys and Wynn day - Mar 18 (Sun) Irosys and Wynn travel to Hollyhock. the last known location of Irosys’ mentor is at the Maelstrom Resort in central Platinum Corner, Hollyhock while traveling, Wynn mentions wanting to talk to Irosys’ mentor due to them both being warlocks at the gate entrance, Irosys is allowed to enter the resort and Wynn is told to wait outside Irosys meets his mentor, “Ava Ire,” and they have a quick discussion. Irosys brings up Wynn wanting to meet her and Ava agrees when Irosys goes to get Wynn, Wynn had already made her way into the resort (by sneaking through the hedge maze) Wynn and Ava meet, and Ava gives advice about how to communicate with her patron taking that advice, Wynn finally has a one-to-one conversation with her patron and leaves the convo having more questions than answers before Irosys and Wynn leave, Ava tells them to visit a subordinate of her’s named “Jason.” Jason has close ties to the Esemone Institute, and could probably help them more than she is able to Irosys and Wynn travel back to the Last Line Tavern

item.title: SESSION 12.5 RECAP
item.description: only Irosys night - Mar 18 (Sun) after helping the rest of the party defeat the 3 thugs at the Last Line tavern, Irosys breaks off and travels to the Tallys’ house staking out the house, Irosys waits as a mailman delivers the letters Diaspro sent to Ava Tally earlier in the day eventually Ava leaves her house with the letters in her hand, and Irosys trails her to intercept Irosys successfully steals the letters off of Ava, but is forced to roof-hop as Ava chases after him from the street Irosys gets cornered on top of a laundromat and poses as a drunkard to avoid suspicion Ava calls over the local AoP, and they arrest Irosys for public intoxication. he is held overnight at the local precinct. Irosys travels back to the Last Line tavern the following morning

item.title: SESSION 10 RECAP
item.description: night - Mar 17 (Sat) he remaining party, either invisible or in mist form, sneak on the next train that takes them out of the mining circle, the rest of the party make their way back to the Last Line Tavern (after quickly defeating a shadowy creature on the side of the road), and promptly all go to sleep while sleeping, Wynn is visited by her patron. through them, Wynn sees a potential future that details fissures running along the magical barrier that surrounds the kingdom. this future is seen as the best outcome after getting caught by the Ivory Guards stationed outside the western entrance of the mines, Diaspro is taken into custody by one of the guards named Thane Thane is tasked with taking her to one of the Guard bases in Anemone to be processed for trespassing on private property and forgery of an official document after getting off the train it's quickly revealed that Thane has no idea where he's going. Diaspro takes this opportunity to take charge and lead them towards the Akkins branch of the Inventor instead once they arrive, Diaspro has Reverend Symon send an expedited letter to her father asking for a legal aid Diaspro then refuses to be moved from this location, forcing Thane to call in the local AoP that will arrive the next morning. before going to sleep, Diaspro takes another look through the temple's small library: she finds a book that talks about a cult that had played a role in the Scorched Petals that was stationed somewhere in the mines while sleeping, Diaspro has a dream reliving a memory. in the dream, Diaspro embodies someone who standing before a shimmering crack floating above an alter. the dream abruptly cuts off as that someone takes the black dagger in their hands and brings it up to their chest day - Mar 18 (Sun) early in the morning the AoP arrive, but Diaspro hides from them until Margret (a personal lawyer for the Lietbriets) arrives.,

item.title: SESSION 9 RECAP
item.description: night - Mar 17 (Sat) after regrouping with Diaspro, the full party discuss how to get around the Yuan and Aerosol fighting after Irosys does some reconnaissance, the party enacts a plan that distracts and obscures the vision of the sky pirates as the party sneaks past them the party fails to sneak past the pirates without being noticed, and Yuan members chase them down a narrow corridor that leads to a chasm with more members before things could escalate into a full on fight, Disapro talks to one of the higher ranked members until Madam Dolores Lotus arrives the Madam and Diaspro have an argument and Diaspro doubles down on the lie as to why she and the rest of party are in the mines before the Yuan leave, a few things are hinted: in certain circles, there is a bounty out for people like Irosys they used an alternative means of leaving the mines, probably by air the Madam's son is the reason why they were there the party then traces back Diaspro's steps towards the end of the puzzle they were originally following the party then traces back Diaspro's steps towards the end of the puzzle they were originally following, in a small cavity to the side, the party meets a white thal miner named Otto, takeaways from their conversation with Otto: Thia reads his mind and relives a meeting between him, Zeke and a mysterious person during a NDA meeting, the only features Thia can pick out is that the mysterious figure has a black band on their left ring finger, an Esemone alumni pin on their expensive-looking shirt, and is holding a red crystal, then the party asks Otto why he is alone, and Otto answers vaguely, Irosys reveals his face and asks Otto earnestly if he's seen his dad, Otto denies ever seeing him, Diaspro then offers Otto 10 gold pieces if he answers honestly, but Otto declines saying "It's not what he needs" and that "It's not enough gold anyway", Otto, in so many words, hints that one of his own is "in trouble" and needs a high-level mage for something, before the party leaves, Kaimop gives Otto the address to the Last Line Tavern and implores him to meet with them tomorrow to talk more about what he needs the party then retraces their steps until they make their way out of cave 10, minus Diaspro, the party uses potions to either turn invisible or into mist and sneak past the Ivory Guards, Diaspro gets caught by said Ivory Guards, and her forged letter doesn't fool them

item.title: Guild of Mechanics
item.description: Consists of many different families but is headed by the Lietbreit Family. The Guild garnered respect and prestige during the Scorched Petals. Rumors have it that the original leader of the guild was blessed by the Inventor with the gift of an innate understanding of mechanics/technology. The Guild can almost be seen as a government body but is more like a bureaucracy. The Guild has a hand in most avenues that rely heavily on mechanics (aka transportation, manufacturing/mining, research/innovation The Lietbriet Family - created hydroelectric power through turbines The Argus Family - created cameras/security systems WIP

item.title: SESSION 1 RECAP
item.description:
night - March 14 (Wed), 6584 a hooded gnome walks into The Last Line Tavern and gets a key to Room 204 from the bartender named Cel a redheaded half-elf and rich-looking wood elf come downstairs from their rooms the redhead buys a shot at the bar, and the wood elf takes a seat at a table a mysterious-looking half-elf is whispering to someone at a table under the stairs the tavern’s newly hired human helper takes a bottle of wine upstairs to room 204
The roomskeeper Xavier loudly summons everyone in the tavern for a game of darts everyone but Cel, the hired helper, the wood elf, and the hooded gnome play the wood elf notices a golden sphere camera floating in the corner of the tavern and alerts Cel Cel calls for Xavier to get the hired helper from upstairs to help reach the camera
Kaimop, the hired helper, knocks the camera down shadowy creatures start appearing from the shadows in the tavern 3 regulars of the tavern make their escape, but everyone else stays and kills the creatures Cel nearly dies trying to get to Xavier 3 military personnel bang on the tavern doors and enter the mysterious half-elf quickly hides behind the tavern bar and the hooded gnome magically blinks out of sight
one of the military personnel, Lt. Nuyi introduces herself as one of The Queen's Cinders Lt. Nuyi goes back and forth with Kaimop over who is in the tavern
Lt. Nuyi talks about similar attacks happening around Anemone for “months now”
Lt. Nuyi tries to recruit those who just fought - giving an audience with The 13th Queen as a form of payment - but is met with resistance
the wood elf, Thia, introduces herself with just her first name Lt. Nuyi explains how to get into contact with her in case anyone changes their minds before leaving, the other 2 military personnel heal Cel and Xavier and wipe their memories the hooded gnome then reappears and reveals that the tavern is enclosed in a domain and that no one can leave for at least a few more hours

item.title: The Scorched Petals
item.description:
Civil war. The kingdom was divided into two main factions: those who still supported the Queen and the Royal Family after The Condemnation, and those that did not. Hollyhock, Edelweiss and Valerian versus Anemone and Amaryllis. The civil war only ended after the Family did a public apology and gave tens of thousands of gold towards Anemone's reconstruction.
The Queen's Cinders were created during this time. The Yuan was created during this time. Guild of Mechanics was legitimized during this time.

item.title: The Condemnation
item.description:
Beginning The 5th Queen started to sweep through Anemone looking for her daughter's kidnappers. She upped taxes, restricted inter-city trade and travel, and increased the Ivory Guard presence in Anemone.Ending
After her mother's sudden passing, The 6th Queen ended The Condemnation on Anemone and officially declared her sister as dead. The 6th Queen later discovered that Emer extremists kidnapped her sister in an act of defiance against the Waterbearer, and killed her. Her sister's body was never found, and the extremists were publicly executed.

item.title: satellite temple
item.description: The building itself is elevated, with a small staircase leading to the front entrance. On either side of the staircase are large white columns that go from ceiling to floor. The front area consists of a lobby that showcases exhibits of older mechanisms native to Anemone. The mechanisms are mining tool and manufacturing technologies. The front area also consists of a front desk. The back section of the temple is the main area. It consists of parallel pews all facing an artsy clock on an intricately designed podium. On either side of the podium are stairs that lead to the second floor. The second floor has three doors leading to offices to the western side. The northern side has a door leading to the temple's library. The eastern side has a door leading to a small storage room. From the second floor, the entirety of the first floor can be seen. A single-story room with shelves of books lining almost every wall. In the center is a cluster of tables, and pressed against the western wall is a couch. Most books only date back a couple of centuries, and the few that don't consist of common texts. Reverend Symon Sister Eryn

item.title: SESSION 8 RECAP
item.description: night - Mar 17 (Sat) the party - minus Diaspro - kill both the large and medium cave spiders. after killing the spiders, the party rushes to pick a burrow opening that could lead out of the den. while looking for a way out, Irosys peaks into a burrow opening and sees an opened spider cocoon soon after choosing an opening, the medium spider that Thia had put to sleep before the battle wakes up and chases them up a narrow crawlspace that leads out of the den once the party digs their way out, they travel up one of the mining pathways that hasn't been walked in a long time. they go through a series of tunnels before walking on a path that has lanterns hanging from above eventually the party hears sounds of metal clinking and clashing, and Irosys scouts ahead to investigate Irosys stumbles upon a scene of 2 opposing sky pirate factions (Aerosol and The Yuan) fighting and arguing. before returning to the group, Irosys overhears the The Yuan members wanting someone returned to them. —— after trying to catch anyone from the party as they sink and fall through loose gravel, Diaspro shouts the remaining directions down to them before continuing through the mines after following the directions, Diaspro makes it to a dead-in as the path ahead looks caved-in. investigating around, Diaspro uncovers a trap door, and uses the rope to travel deeper underground Diaspro then travels and explores an array of different tunnels before sticking to one that has a metal door in its side. making her way inside, she looks around a locker-room like space before taking a blue-lit lantern, and a black dagger that a skeleton hand was clutching closely making her way out of the room and path into the mining pathways, Diaspro follows the similar sound of metal clinking and clashing, and joins the rest of the party

item.description: day - Mar 18 (Sun) Margret Bering is able to release Diaspro from custody due to insufficient evidence of Diaspro’s crime. Diaspro rejoins the party at the Last Line tavern Kaimop and Diaspro have an argument, ending with Diaspro heading back to her tavern-room. Irosys then talks to Kaimop, trying to empathize with him over Diaspro’s attitude eventually Kaimop, Thia, Irosys and Wynn discuss what to say to the white thal miners. they decide to have Irosys and Wynn travel to Hollyhock to visit Irosys’ mentor, someone they think could be of help Diaspro joins the discussion and gives Kaimop a non-dangerous looking potion Irosys and Wynn leave and the rest of the party wait for Otto to arrive Otto and Yarla (another white thal miner) arrive and they have a talk main points of the talk: neither Otto nor Yarla recognize the black dagger, mysterious clock, or fissures that Diaspro saw in her dreams Kaimop tells them about the shadowy figures Otto and Yarla hint that until the party comes up with a better solution, they will be following their “initial plan” Otto and Yarla promise to send a letter later in the day asking for updates

SESSION 7 RECAP
item.description: night - March 17 (Sat) in order to sneak past the guards to the mines, the party plans to create a explosion that will distract the guards while they slip their way past the gate while sneaking around, the party notices the upped security due to the recent theft of white thal after successfully sneaking around the Ivory Guard patrolling the cave entrance, the party uses the symbol found on Rus' letter to navigate the different pathways while making their way through the mines, the party - minus Diaspro - sinks into loose gravel and fall 60ft into a large cave hub Thia is the first to notice a large spider along the roof of den the large spider jumps down despite Thia's attempt to make it fall asleep (she manages to put a medium spider to sleep), and the battle begins

item.title: SESSION 6 RECAP
item.description: night - March 16 (Fri) the party returns to The Last Line Tavern and go to bed early day - March 17 (Sat) early the next morning, the party discuss a plan for sneaking into the mines as part of the plan, Kaimop and Wynn get mining clothes/gear while Diaspro, Thia and Irosys go to Eora’s Bank to withdraw money Diaspro withdraws enough money to cover the cost of 5 potions while out and about, each member of the party sends out letters (some thinking it might be for the last time)

item.title: SESSION 5 RECAP
item.description:
day - March 16 (Fri) Kaimop and Wynn (K&W) arrive at Mariana’s house and let themselves in Kaimop convinces Mariana to show her blackened fingertips, but Wynn is unable to discern anything about them K&W learn that Mariana’s deceased fiancé, Gabriel, use to work in the white thal mines before dying in a sudden cave collapse K&W borrow Gabriel’s lockerbox and discover the false bottom. They take a metal key with an engraved number “10” from the false bottom K&W then head towards Rus’ house before getting on a bullet train back to Anemone, Diaspro and Thia (D&T) stop at Eora’s Bank and check their bank accounts/withdraw money K&W and D&T met with each other before making their way to Rus’ house these 4 met with Rus’ wife, Ava, and promise to pay for Rus’ bond in exchange for her telling them everything she knows. Irosys arrives at Rus’ house. Ava gives the party Rus’ lockerbox and inside was: picture of current generation of white thal miners a keycard of Zerin’s a note with an unusual drawing at the end of it
the party head to the 4th Ward District AoP precinct to somehow talk to Rus the party devise a plan to get Kaimop arrested, thus giving them a reason to be at the precinct Diaspro pays Rus’ bond and asks demands he be transported to her mother Diaspro and Rus have a mental conversation, and she confirms that he is unable to reveal much (in relation to the kidnapping of Irosys’ father). However, he does plead he never stole any white thal
the party leaves the precinct and come to conclusion that they head to the Mining Circle
